minerals.name: Key of Life

trivia: The original odds for Key of Life were 1 in 96,815,312,601, i.e. almost 1 in 100 billion.

locations.name: Abyssal Depths
locations.summary: Abyssal Depths is an underground sub-location wherein the darkness seems to surround you from every direction.

locations.name: Ancient Ruins
locations.summary: The Ancient Ruins are a discoverable landmark located within the Windswept Beach area.

locations.name: Azuralite Oasis
locations.summary: Azuralite Oasis is a sub-area of the Crystal Caverns on Mainland.

locations.name: Caldera Park
locations.summary: Caldera Park is a location around and in the Volcano. It is restricted to level 20 and up.

locations.name: Crystal Caverns
locations.summary: Crystal Caverns is a location on the Mainland.

locations.name: Deeproot Spring
locations.summary: Deeproot Spring is a sub-location within Overgrown Grotto.

locations.name: Enchanted Ruins
locations.summary: Enchanted Ruins is a sublocation within Deeproot Spring.

locations.name: Fortune River
locations.summary: Fortune River is the second major location on the Mainland.

locations.name: Fortune River Delta
locations.summary: Fortune River Delta is a location on the Mainland.

locations.name: Frostbitten Path
locations.summary: Frostbitten Path is a location on Snowy Mountain.

locations.name: Frozen Peak
locations.summary: Frozen Peak is a location on Snowy Mountain.

locations.name: Fungal Marsh
locations.summary: The Fungal Marsh is a location in the Rotwood swamp area. To reach it, go to the town in Rotwood Swamp, then follow the path in either direction.

locations.name: Haunted Creek
locations.summary: Haunted Creek is a location inside the Halloween Event portal.

locations.name: Meteor Valley
locations.summary: Meteor Valley is a location found behind the Timelocked Sanctuary, near The Greatest Prospector.

locations.name: Museum
locations.summary: The Museum is an indoor location in Caldera Park where players can place minerals into display pedestals to earn permanent stat boosts.

locations.name: North Pole
locations.summary: North Pole is a location inside the Christmas Event portal.

locations.name: Overgrown Grotto
locations.summary: Overgrown Grotto is a location accessible from the Azuralite Oasis through a locked door.

locations.name: Rotwood Swamp
locations.summary: The entrance of the Rotwood Swamp location is across the river and a bit upstream from the dock at Fortune River.

locations.name: Rubble Creek
locations.summary: Rubble Creek is the first location the player visits on Mainland.

locations.name: Seashell Isle
locations.summary: Seashell Isle is the location of the Summer Event. It is a moving island that floats around on its own, and is only close enough to the mainland to sail to in the summer.

locations.name: Snowy Shores
locations.summary: Snowy Shores is a location on Snowy Mountain.

locations.name: Sunset Beach
locations.summary: Sunset Beach is a location on the Mainland.

locations.name: The Magma Furnace
locations.summary: The Magma Furnace is a location in Caldera Park.

locations.name: The Void
locations.summary: The Void is a mysterious location that appears as a rift in reality.

locations.name: Volcanic Sands
locations.summary: Volcanic Sands is a location in Caldera Park.

locations.name: Volcanic Springs
locations.summary: Volcanic Springs is a location on Caldera Island between Volcanic Sands and the volcano.

locations.name: Volcano
locations.summary: The Volcano is an island containing several locations.

locations.name: Windswept Beach
locations.summary: Windswept Beach is a location in Caldera Park.

pans.name: Rusty Pan
pans.description: A rusty pan for gold panning.
pans.source: Given to the player upon joining.

pans.name: Plastic Pan
pans.description: A lightweight pan made from wear-resistant plastic.

pans.name: Metal Pan
pans.description: A large and heavy metal pan made from sheet metal.

pans.name: Silver Pan
pans.description: A shining silver pan.

pans.name: Golden Pan
pans.description: A gold-plated pan carved with intricate designs. Provides a strong boost to luck.

pans.name: Magnetic Pan
pans.description: A pan with a built-in magnet. Collected minerals have 25% more weight.

pans.name: Meteoric Pan
pans.description: A pan forged from meteoric iron. Has a higher chance to find modifiers.

pans.name: Diamond Pan
pans.description: A diamond-encrusted pan with incredible durability and strength.

pans.name: Aurora Pan
pans.description: A pan infused with light.

pans.name: Obsidian Pan
pans.description: An obsidian pan. Special enchantments make the normally brittle obsidian extremely strong.

pans.name: Worldshaker
pans.description: A relic from an ancient civilization. Despite its age, immense power still lies within.

pans.name: Dragonflame Pan
pans.description: A scorching pan that melts through sand. However, its heat reduces the size of ore by 10%.

pans.name: Fossilized Pan
pans.description: An ancient bone pan that has been fossilized with age.

pans.name: Frostbite Pan
pans.description: A frozen pan from deep within the mountain.

pans.name: Lifetouched Pan
pans.description: A pan formed by nature.

pans.name: Blightflow Pan
pans.description: A cursed pan that is corrosive to the touch

pans.name: Nebula Pan
pans.description: A pan forged from astral materials. Resonates with nearby totems, benefitting more from their effects.
pans.passive: +25% Modifier Boost, +33% Size Boost, Increased buffs from Totems, 1.1× additional Luck

pans.name: Pharaoh's Pan
pans.description: A pan once used by the ruler of a long-lost civilization.
pans.passive: +20% Modifier Boost, +40% Sell Boost, +40% Size Boost, [temporary: increased buffs from totems]

pans.name: Galactic Pan
pans.description: A pan with immense capacity formed from the stars. Has a chance to give 'Voidtorn' to found items.
pans.passive: +25% Size Boost, and has a chance to give Voidtorn items

pans.name: Pumpkin Pan
pans.description: The pan of the Pumpkin King. Summons a ghostly spirit to assist with panning. This spirit is boosted when used with the Pumpking Shovel.

pans.name: Gingerbread Pan
pans.description: A tasty gingerbread pan. Has a chance to give the effects of an XP cookie after panning.
pans.passive: Chance to give XP cookie effects

pans.name: Rose Pan
pans.description: A pan made from rose petals. Gains 25% of a nearby player's luck and shares 25% of your luck back to them.

shovels.description: A shovel once used by the ruler of a long-lost civilization.

sluices.name: Wood Sluice Box
sluices.description: A box that automatically filters valuables from running water, even when offline!

sluices.name: Steel Sluice Box
sluices.description: A standard sluice box used by prospectors to filter for gold. Collects offline!

sluices.name: Gold Sluice Box
sluices.description: A high quality sluice plated with gold, protecting it from corrosion.

sluices.name: Obsidian Sluice Box
sluices.description: A sleek obsidian sluice that cuts through the water, allowing it to sift valuables with ease.

sluices.description: A sluice enchanted with a variety of powerful spells, boosting its luck and efficiency at the cost of capacity.

sluices.name: Dragonflame Sluice
sluices.description: A draconic sluice that turns ore into fuel, leaving only the most valuable behind.

sluices.name: Fossilized Sluice
sluices.description: An ancient sluice that has been fossilized with age. Incredibly slow, but provides great yield once full.

sluices.name: Arctic Sluice
sluices.description: An icy and fast sluice designed for cold arctic waters.

sluices.name: Lifetouched Sluice
sluices.description: A living sluice that feeds on sediment, leaving valuable ore behind.

sluices.name: Corroded Sluice
sluices.description: A standard sluice box used by prospectors to filter for gold. Collect offline!

sluices.name: Starblossom Sluice
sluices.description: A sluice with an strange alien flower growing on it, feeding on ores that pass through.

sluices.name: Pharaoh's Sluice
sluices.description: A sluice box forged for the ruler of an ancient empire.

sluices.name: Easter Sluice
sluices.description: An easter-themed sluice. Grants a powerful temporary boost to your stats when collected based on how full it is.
